description.en: The ID of the application that you want to configure.
The permissions of the Developer API feature.

title.zh: 设置一个EIAM应用的Developer API授权范围

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-application-grant-scope --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --grant-scopes urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:user:read_all --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetApplicationGrantScope --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --GrantScopes.1 'urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:user:read_all' --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --method POST --force
